title: Divine MP Yatra – Ujjain & Omkareshwar
highlights: Optional Bhasma Aarti (self-booked, subject to temple rules)
Darshan at Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga on Mandhata Island
Visit Mamleshwar Temple across the Narmada
Kal Bhairav Temple & Harsiddhi Mata Temple
Ram Ghat on the sacred Shipra River
Comfortable transport from Indore with Trip Captain
overview: Embark on a divine 2 Jyotirlinga spiritual journey with TripWithMe and seek the blessings of Lord Shiva at two of Madhya Pradesh's most sacred pilgrimage destinations — Shri Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga in holy Ujjain and Shri Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga on the sacred banks of the Narmada River. This memorable 3 Days / 2 Nights journey combines spiritual experiences with the scenic beauty of Jaam Gate Valley, the royal heritage of Maheshwar, Ahilya Fort, and the peaceful surroundings of Sahastradhara. Enjoy temple darshans, beautiful landscapes, local food, and unforgettable moments with your loved ones. Har Har Mahadev!

itinerary.title: Ujjain Arrival | Shri Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan & Local Sightseeing
activities: Arrive in the holy city of Ujjain and get ready for a peaceful and spiritual journey with TripWithMe.
Visit the sacred Shri Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Temple and seek the blessings of Baba Mahakal.
Explore the famous Kaal Bhairav Temple, one of the most revered temples in Ujjain.
Visit the beautiful Harsiddhi Mata Mandir and experience its divine spiritual atmosphere.
Explore Chardham Temple and other famous religious attractions of Ujjain.
Spend some peaceful moments exploring the spiritual surroundings and capturing memorable photographs.
After completing the sightseeing, return to your hotel and relax.
Enjoy your overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Jaam Gate | Maheshwar Sightseeing & Heritage Exploration
activities: Wake up to a refreshing morning and enjoy breakfast at the hotel.
Complete the checkout formalities and get ready for an exciting journey towards Jaam Gate.
Visit the beautiful Jaam Gate Valley, famous for its breathtaking landscapes, lush greenery, and scenic mountain views.
Enjoy the peaceful natural surroundings and capture beautiful photographs at this picturesque destination.
Continue your journey towards the historic town of Maheshwar, situated along the holy Narmada River.
Explore the magnificent Ahilya Fort, known for its rich history, royal architecture, and connection with Devi Ahilyabai Holkar.
Visit Sahastradhara, a beautiful natural attraction where the Narmada River flows through rocky formations.
Enjoy the famous traditional Dal Bafla, a popular and delicious local food of Madhya Pradesh.
After a memorable day of sightseeing, relax and enjoy your overnight stay as per the travel arrangement.

itinerary.title: Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan | Mamleshwar Temple & Trip Departure
activities: Wake up to a beautiful morning and get ready for the final day of your spiritual journey.
Travel towards Omkareshwar, one of the most sacred pilgrimage destinations in Madhya Pradesh.
Visit Shri Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Temple and seek the divine blessings of Lord Shiva.
Explore the sacred Mamleshwar Mahadev Temple, another important temple associated with the Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga pilgrimage.
Experience the peaceful spiritual atmosphere near the holy Narmada River and enjoy the beautiful surroundings.
Spend some time exploring the temple area, capturing photographs, and collecting unforgettable memories.
After completing the darshan and sightseeing, begin your return journey.
With the blessings of Baba Mahakal and Omkareshwar Mahadev, conclude your memorable spiritual journey with TripWithMe.
Har Har Mahadev! Travel More • Explore More • Live More!

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: If cancellations are made 60-30 days before the trip's start date, 10% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made 30 days before the trip's start date, 50% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made within 0-30 days before the trip's start date, 100% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. In case of unforeseen weather conditions or government restrictions, certain activities may be canceled, and in such cases, the operator will try his best to provide an alternate feasible activity. However, no refund will be provided for the same.

faq.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faq.answer: The tour starts with pickup from Indore and concludes with drop-off at Indore.

faq.question: Which Jyotirlingas are covered in this package?
faq.answer: This package covers Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga in Ujjain and Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga, along with Mamleshwar Temple.

faq.question: Is Bhasma Aarti included?
faq.answer: No. Bhasma Aarti requires advance online booking by the traveler and is subject to temple rules and availability.

faq.question: Can senior citizens join this trip?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a comfortable road trip with moderate walking at temples, suitable for senior devotees who can manage temple queues.

faq.question: Will all sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary be covered?
faq.answer: Yes, subject to temple timings, crowd conditions, traffic and weather.
